import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

commands=[['.venv/bin/ruff','check','src','tests','scripts','train'],
          ['cmake','--build','build/native','-j','2'],
          ['ctest','--test-dir','build/native','--output-on-failure'],
          ['cmake','--build','build/sanitize','-j','2'],
          ['ctest','--test-dir','build/sanitize','--output-on-failure'],
          ['.venv/bin/python','-c','from makemarket.engine import cpp_available; assert cpp_available()']]
env=dict(os.environ,ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0',UBSAN_OPTIONS='print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1')
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'verify current local code and native safety while hosted CI is blocked by account billing'}),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'environment_overrides':{k:env[k] for k in ('ASAN_OPTIONS','UBSAN_OPTIONS')},
        'python_verification':'results/verification_validation_amendment.json','checks':[],
        'scope':'macOS local fallback only, not a green GitHub-hosted Ubuntu/Python matrix. LeakSanitizer disabled for this local ASan/UBSan check.'}
for i,command in enumerate(commands):
    start=time.monotonic()
    completed=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
    log=Path(f'runs/ci-local-{i}.log')
    log.write_text(completed.stdout)
    record['checks'].append({'command':command,'exit_code':completed.returncode,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,
                             'output':completed.stdout,'output_sha256':file_sha256(log)})
    print(' '.join(command),completed.returncode,flush=True)
    if completed.returncode:
        break
record['status']='passed' if len(record['checks'])==len(commands) and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in record['checks']) else 'failed'
record['source_sha256']={str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in [Path('CMakeLists.txt'),*Path('cpp').rglob('*.cpp'),*Path('cpp').rglob('*.hpp')]}
Path('results/verification_ci_local_fallback.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert record['status']=='passed'
